name: Northbridge 10-year cardiovascular risk (teaching model)
limits: Trained on synthetic data for teaching — not validated on real patients.
Training ranges: age 30–79, systolic BP 90–200 mmHg, cholesterol 120–400 mg/dL, max heart rate 70–205 bpm; outside these the model extrapolates.
Gives a population risk estimate, not a diagnosis and not a treatment decision.
No external validation, no calibration study, no regulatory clearance (IVDR / FDA).
